title: genista hirsuta
intro: Genista hirsuta, commonly known as hairy broom or hairy genistal, is a perennial plant in the Fabaceae family. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to treat various health issues such as fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Genista hirsuta include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of soothing and calming the body. The bioactive constituents of Genista hirsuta include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
